items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to Dweck's fixed and growth mindsets, praise, self-efficacy, and Willingham's critique of learning styles.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: Episodes on motivation, self-belief and educational psychology directly complement Dweck's mindset research.

items.title: The power of believing that you can improve | Carol Dweck | TED
items.description: The primary researcher herself explains growth mindset — the central theory of this lesson.

items.title: Carol Dweck — A Study on Praise and Mindsets
items.description: Dweck's own presentation on the experimental research linking praise type to mindset — directly maps onto the lesson's content on effort vs ability praise.

items.title: The Super Mario Effect — Tricking Your Brain into Learning More | Mark Rober | TEDxPenn
items.description: Illustrates how reframing failure supports a growth mindset — a memorable example for exam application questions.

items.title: The Social Dilemma
items.description: Explores how tech platforms exploit motivation and self-belief — a contemporary context for discussing self-efficacy and external reinforcement.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology 8182 — Specification
items.description: Confirms the required content on Dweck's mindsets, self-efficacy and Willingham's learning-styles critique for the AQA exam.
